text: Teaching objectives The certificate courses are designed for non-degree seeking short-term and exchange students who will spend one or two semesters in China. The content of courses range from introductory to specialized, contemporary Chinese business concerns. Main courses Chinese Culture & Business Etiquette, Strategic Management in China, Markets & Marketing, Introduction to Money and Finance, The Changing Chinese Business Environment, Developing a Business in China. Chinese Economic Reform, M&A, Chinese Tax System and Business Law, Insight Chinese Trade and FDI, The Government and Politics in China, Chinese
